title: Stock Not Stack
style: Minimal cold pop-rap with a stark 72 BPM pulse, sparse sub hits, dry rim clicks, and a repetitive two-chord loop; verse stays stripped to voice, bass, and clipped percussion, pre-chorus narrows to a single drone and hand taps, chorus lands with doubled chant vocals and a short pause after each hook phrase. Add tiny tape-stop cuts, low reversed swells, and room-tone tails between lines. Intimate close-mic mix, icy and bare, with a hard center and lots of empty space., simple, minimal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep saying stack
I don’t need that
One thing held
Not built
Not layered
Not promised

Same grim grin
Same sickle
Same conversation
You hand me more
I ask for less
You miss the point

[Pre-Chorus]
I want one line
I want one thing
Held in place
Held in place

No extra weight
No extra scheme
Just what I asked
Just what I need

[Chorus]
Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
One thing held
One thing held

Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
I don’t want more
I want one

[Verse 2]
I said stock
You said stack
Again
Again

I said held
You said built
Like that was better
Like that was enough

No gaps
You say
No gaps
I say
That’s not the ask

[Pre-Chorus]
I want one line
I want one thing
Held in place
Held in place

No extra weight
No extra scheme
Just what I asked
Just what I need

[Chorus]
Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
One thing held
One thing held

Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
I don’t want more
I want one

[Bridge]
No promise dressed up
No pile of names
No clever grin
No spin again

Hear me plain
Hear me plain
Stock
Not stack

[Final Chorus]
Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
One thing held
One thing held

Stock, not stack
Stock, not stack
I don’t want more
I want one
